ai.title: AI Configuration
ai.desc: Configure LLM access parameters (pi-ai multi-provider); saved to the brain service and shared with Feishu
ai.systemPromptPlaceholder: Blank uses the default Kurisu persona
ai.loginRequired: Log in on the Companion page first
ai.toolsDesc: Let the assistant use tools: time, calculator, weather, web search, terminal commands (dangerous commands are blocked by the safety policy)

feishu.title: Feishu
feishu.desc: Bind your Feishu account to chat with Amadeus there (shares sessions with the desktop)
feishu.hint: DM the bot in Feishu and send this code to bind

skills.title: Skill Management
skills.desc: Skills are file-based (one directory per skill, each with a SKILL.md). The assistant reads a skill when a task matches; toggling takes effect immediately, and editing files needs no restart
skills.empty: No skills yet. Create <skill-name>/SKILL.md (with name and description in the YAML frontmatter) in the directory below, then refresh

general.title: General
general.desc: Appearance and startup preferences, stored only on this device
general.themeHint: Companion mode always uses the dark lab theme
general.defaultMute: Mute by default in Companion mode
general.defaultMuteDesc: When on, voice playback starts muted in Companion mode (toggle anytime in the HUD)

config.title: Configuration
config.modelDebugHint: Models other than Kurisu have no custom emotion faces or comic overlays; use them to debug model loading, lip sync, and motions.
config.previewHint: Click to preview. During voice chat the AI switches expressions and gestures automatically.
